name: css-author
description: Phase 5 of the site build: turns a verify_build defect list plus the real rendered DOM into override.css rules. The only stage after interpretation that needs a model — writing a rule that fixes a defect without breaking other pages is judgement, not a lookup. Runs in a fresh context window so DOM dumps never reach the caller. Writes one CSS file to the site workspace and returns a compact status JSON; the harness uploads it.
